evidence.title: WA PI Agent rpc-client
evidence.finding: Production spawn uses configured runtime with the actual Pi Coding Agent CLI path and --mode rpc plus session args, cwd and inherited/configured environment. Pi package entrypoint is resolved from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent; not an OpenCode model-provider alias.

evidence.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-src-agent-manager-ts
evidence.locator: AgentManager module contract lines 1–10, per-session handle map and spawn path around line 1644
evidence.finding: Kernel maintains one Pi RPC subprocess per WA PI session, owning lifecycle, queues and event/UI routing. Independent subprocess does not imply a container or restricted filesystem.

evidence.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-src-delegate-tool-ts
evidence.locator: delegate execute lines 408–458, runWithConcurrency lines 552+ and results map lines 895–954
evidence.finding: Product delegate tool validates task array, starts/resumes subagent instances through its configured spawn function, executes with bounded concurrency, and returns aggregated per-worker status/result text, transcript paths and usage; full details drive inspectable UI.

evidence.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-src-scheduler-ts
evidence.locator: toCronExpression lines 10–50; register Bun.cron lines 152+; runTaskNow and interrupted-run reconciliation lines 188–246
evidence.finding: Product-owned local Bun.cron dispatcher converts minute/hourly/daily/weekdays/weekly/monthly/custom schedules using host local time, records running executions and reconciles abandoned running records as interrupted after restart. No managed cloud or offline catch-up guarantee established.

evidence.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-assets-scheduled-tasks-readme-md
evidence.locator: Task directory contract and frontmatter example; schedules and common operations
evidence.finding: Per-project tasks/<id>.md stores schedule/role/enabled/frontmatter plus instruction body; logs/<id>.log appends run status/details. Bundled cron-task.ts management CLI adds/lists/runs/disables tasks; saved Markdown hot reloads.
